question: Which of the following countries will restrict the Mt. Everest Permit to only those who have already climbed 7000 m?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nepal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nepal** has decided to restrict permits for climbing **Mount Everest** to only those climbers who have prior experience of scaling a peak of at least **7,000 meters**.
 
• This decision was made to ensure the **safety of climbers** and to regulate the increasing number of climbers attempting to summit the world's highest peak.
 
• **Mount Everest**, which stands at an elevation of **8,848.86 meters**, is located in the **Himalayas** and is shared by Nepal and Tibet (China).
 
• The restriction aims to reduce the risks associated with inexperienced climbers, as **Everest expeditions** are known for their harsh conditions, including **altitude sickness, avalanches, and unpredictable weather.**
 
• Climbers will now need to demonstrate their prior experience and fitness level, making **climbing permits** a more regulated process.
 
• Nepal is home to **eight of the world's fourteen highest peaks**, making it a hub for **mountaineering enthusiasts** worldwide.
 
• This restriction also addresses concerns about **overcrowding** on Everest, which has led to dangerous situations in the past, including long traffic jams near the summit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Mongolia**__

 __
 
• **Mongolia** is a landlocked country in **East Asia**, known for its vast steppes and nomadic culture.
 
• It is not associated with **Mount Everest** or any major mountain climbing activities.
 
 
 
• **USA**__
 __
 
• The **USA** is a country in **North America** and is home to notable peaks such as **Denali** (formerly Mount McKinley).
 
• It is not related to Mount Everest, which is located in the **Himalayas**.
 
 
 
• **Japan**__
 
 
• **Japan** is an island nation in **East Asia**, known for its iconic peak, **Mount Fuji**.
 
• Japan is not involved in issuing permits for Mount Everest.
